highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Established in 1991, Edith Cowan University (ECU) has quickly grown into a world-class institution known for its "world-ready" graduates. Named after the first woman elected to an Australian Parliament, the university carries a legacy of breaking barriers and promoting equality. While it is a young university, it consistently outshines older institutions in student satisfaction and teaching quality, holding a 5-star rating for undergraduate teaching for 19 consecutive years.

The university is organised into eight diverse schools: Arts & Humanities, Business & Law Education, Engineering, Medical & Health Sciences, Nursing & Midwifery Science, Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts (WAAPA)

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At ECU, you’ll find a multicultural campus culture with students from over 100 countries. The university experience is built around community, supported by the ECU Student Guild, which oversees numerous clubs and societies. Whether you are interested in the Coding Club, the Cyber Competition Club, or joining the Students Software Society (SSS), there is a place for you to connect with like-minded peers.

To ensure you feel supported, ECU provides extensive services, including psychological counselling, health services, and academic pathway programs like UniPrep for those transitioning into university-level study.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
ECU offers convenient on-campus living through ECU Village, managed by Campus Living Villages. These villages provide a friendly environment with various apartment styles to suit different budgets, from single studio rooms to shared multi-room units.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

ECU Libraries provide you with extensive digital collections, quiet study zones, and collaborative spaces. You can access specialised resources and expert assistance at each of the main campuses.

2. Sports

You’ll have access to modern sports and fitness centres. Facilities include gyms, court options for various sports, and organised fitness classes to help you stay active between lectures.

3. Laboratories

ECU is home to high-tech environments, including advanced computer labs and specialised science facilities. The university features unique spaces like the STEM wing and performance studios at WAAPA.

4. Cafeteria

You won’t go hungry on campus due to its wide variety of dining options. Popular spots include Six Street Cafe, Birra Bar, Bermuda ECU, Plantation, and Slice of Italy.
